full_judgment: 3. The respondent No.7 petitioner appearing in the suit filed an application for vacating the order of stay stating, inter alia that 1.05 acres of land was purchased by Bhubon Mohan Ghosh vide Sale Deed No.2615 dated 04.07.1928 from Elahi Box driver. That said Bhubon Mohan Ghosh filed Title Suit No.1537 of 1929 for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession so far it relates to C.S. Plot No.94. That suit was dismissed on contested on 23.03.1931 but the findings were in favour of the plaintiff as regards to C.S. Dag No. 65. The trial Court observed that plaintiff purchased some lands within the certain well defined boundaries and he had got possession of the same and under the circumstances of this case he could not claim anything more, so it is clear that Bhubon Mohan Ghosh and thereafter his successors including respondent No.7, his mother and 7 brothers and sisters have been possessing the land in question of CS. Plot No. 65, within the same boundaries. That Bhubon Mohan Ghosh transferred 1.05 acres of land to one Mamnoor Rashid Khan vide Sale Deed No. 4158 dated 05.09.1951. That Mamnoor Rashid khan transferred 1.05 acres of land to Nazmen Nur Begum, mother of the respondent No.7, to Nuruzzaman, brother of respondent No. 7 and to respondent No. 7 and his another brother Muraduzzaman vide 3 gift deeds Nos. 17774, 17776 and 17775 respectively in the year 1963. After the demise of Nuruzzaman in 1972 leaving no wife or children his portion of the land was recorded in the name of Nazmen Nur Begum respondent No.7 and his 3 other full brothers and 4 sisters. That the respondent No. 7, his mother and 7 full brothers and sisters are the legal owners of land in question in C.S. Plot Nos. 65, 94 and part of 95 and have been possessing the aforesaid land in question for the last 57 years. That the respondent No. 7 submitted a plan to RAJUK and after proper enquiry RAJUK approved the plan on 13.12.2006 for 16 storied commercial building. Subsequently, the respondent No.7 executed a contract with a developer named Pioneer Builders Limited who has taken a Loan of TK. 15 crore from the Bank.
